The '''Bid'jerma Detention Block''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bid'jerma]]. The prison was located in a remote area and had a high concentration of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] prisoners. After fifty Alliance [[operative]]s were transferred to Bid'jerma Detention Block, [[Outpost Cinder]] was established by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] to monitor the base and determine if a jailbreak was possible. [[Team Blade]], led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Teracca Torrh]], was tasked with developing a preliminary assault plan.<ref name="HS" />
